keyEntries.responseText: 71 over 42 is already in lowest terms.
explanation: Use 42 as the least common denominator. The least common denominator is 42.
Rewrite the first addend with the common denominator. 6 over 7 equals 36 over 42.
Rewrite the second addend with the common denominator. 5 over 6 equals 35 over 42.
Add the numerators while keeping the common denominator. 36 plus 35 over 42 is 71 over 42.
Check the fraction. It is already in lowest terms. 71 over 42 is already in lowest terms.
